rules.sentence: Inflammatory bowel disease includes either Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
Ulcerative colitis is confined to the large intestine, whereas Crohn's disease can occur anywhere in the GI tract, from mouth to anus.

Ischemic colitis is more common in the elderly and occurs when there is decreased blood flow to the colon.
Decreased blood flow can cause inflammation or injury to the colon.
Some causes of ischemic colitis are atherosclerosis of arteries, low blood pressure, blood clots, and bowel obstruction.
